description: Pythia R1 Source Registry: canonical allowlist of 8 public data sources for evidence collection.

sources.platform: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
sources.primacy_context: Official publisher of Effective Federal Funds Rate (EFFR) daily benchmark reference rates.
sources.proposed_cadence: Business days around 09:00 ET following publication.
sources.freshness_definition: Latest rate observation published on preceding business day (max age 24h on business days, 96h over weekends/holidays).

sources.primacy_context: Official publisher of FOMC monetary policy statements, discount rate votes, and implementation notes.
sources.proposed_cadence: Scheduled FOMC release days at ~14:00 ET and unscheduled emergency release windows.
sources.freshness_definition: Feed item publication timestamp matching official statement release time.

sources.primacy_context: Official verbatim transcripts and remarks delivered by Federal Reserve Board governors and regional bank presidents.
sources.proposed_cadence: Continuous polling on business days during US working hours (embargo lift windows).
sources.freshness_definition: Feed item publication timestamp reflecting speech delivery / embargo lift.

sources.platform: Bureau of Labor Statistics (U.S. Department of Labor)
sources.primacy_context: Official publisher of monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) summary press releases.
sources.proposed_cadence: Monthly scheduled release dates at 08:30 ET.
sources.freshness_definition: Feed item publication timestamp matching scheduled BLS CPI release.

validation_rules.known_limitation: Endpoint historically returned HTTP 403 Forbidden due to automated access protections. Retained as canonical target without bypassing protections.

sources.primacy_context: Official model tracking estimate for real GDP growth produced by Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta researchers.
sources.proposed_cadence: 5-7 times per month according to official GDPNow release calendar following source data releases.
sources.freshness_definition: Latest model forecast date indicated on official web page.

validation_rules.known_limitation: HTML transport verified; substantive content extraction and numerical table parser unverified in R1.

sources.primacy_context: Official software code repository releases and tags for DeepSeek-V3 repository (technical sample for AI lab activity).
sources.freshness_definition: Release publication timestamp published_at from GitHub API.

validation_rules.known_limitation: Technical sample of a specific repository, not a comprehensive AI watchlist. Unauthenticated requests subject to GitHub 60 req/hour rate limits.

sources.primacy_context: Official model hub repository entries and weights published under the deepseek-ai namespace (technical sample for AI lab activity).
sources.freshness_definition: lastModified timestamp from Hugging Face model metadata.

validation_rules.known_limitation: Technical sample of author namespace, not a comprehensive AI watchlist.

sources.primacy_context: Third-party community benchmark evaluation / Elo leaderboard for LLM models under overall no-style-control category.
sources.freshness_definition: Timestamp of latest leaderboard leaderboard update as stated on page.

validation_rules.known_limitation: Endpoint historically returned HTTP 403 Forbidden under Cloudflare automated protection. Retained as canonical target without bypassing protections; extraction unverified.
